intended_object: Per its docstring, this is the map that sends a morphism in the category `Lat` of lattices back to the underlying bundled `LatticeHom`. It is a piece of the concrete-category API.
explanation: I judged this from the code shown, without searching the library. The definition is an `abbrev` for `ConcreteCategory.hom (C := Lat) f`. This follows the standard Mathlib pattern for bundled categories: it turns a categorical morphism into the underlying bundled lattice homomorphism. It is a bookkeeping projection inside the category-theory framework. It does not formalize any mathematical notion of its own, so it is an implementation detail. As an implementation it is correct: it simply calls the general `ConcreteCategory.hom` for `Lat`.
